name: 0.1-10x Weather Changes
description: The weather changes on its own more or less often: 0.1 to 10 times as often, as you choose with the 0.1-10x Weather Changes slider in the patcher window (it reads -10 to 10: 10 is 10 times, -10 a tenth, -2 half, and 1, the middle, the normal game; 1 unless you move it; type it in the box beside the slider too). Every natural spell of weather (the weather's own turns: the start of a village's weather, clear weather giving way to another kind, and back to clear) lasts its normal length divided by the number: normally clear weather lasts 8 to 30 minutes and any other kind 3 to 6, on the game's clock (real-life minutes on Normal speed; the clock runs twice as fast on Fast, 0.6 times on Slow, and stops while paused). So at 2 clear weather lasts 4 to 15 minutes and any other kind 1.5 to 3; never less than 1 second. Weather that an island event or anything else brings on, at once or next in line, lasts exactly as in the normal game. Which kind comes next is the game's own. A spell already under way when the game starts keeps its end. Rain and storms build up their strength 5 points every 6 seconds, so at high numbers spells are short and the strength rarely reaches 50, above which mushrooms and collectibles get a second chance to appear. **Needs no other patch.** Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it, with the slider at 1. **Unverified in play** (checked by emulation of the game's own code). The companion is "VVFP Weather Frequency.dll", started by VVFP More Companions.dll, and the slider's number is written beside it in "VVFP Weather Frequency.txt"; nothing is written to a save.
behavior_changes: 0.1-10x Weather Changes: the companion's sites 0x46BD1D, 0x46BD22, 0x46BD29, 0x46BD2E, 0x46BDF8, 0x46C103, 0x46C113 (see runtime_detours), installed only when the slider is not 1; N is read at start from "VVFP Weather Frequency.txt" beside the companion in tenths (0.1 to 10; none is 1).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes its sites at run time, only after verifying their stock bytes (all of them, or none; an optional site another patch owns is left alone).
At 1x nothing is installed. The game's rand is never drawn more or less often: the companion's chances are its own numbers.
Nothing is written to a save, a villager record or a file; no text is shown.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly of the stock executable; the companion's install and its effect emulated on the rendered executable (tests/test_new_sliders.py); runtime/player confirmation pending
